summary: First iteration testing of QuickYield (React+FastAPI+MongoDB rebuild). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passing covering auth, opportunities, meta, watchlist CRUD, alerts CRUD, settings. Frontend: landing, auth modal (register/login/error), session persistence via qy_token localStorage, nav guard, dashboard layout with 4 sidebar items, opportunities list (500 pools loaded from DeFiLlama), filters/sort UI, add-to-watchlist, page transitions between sections, settings toggle and digest frequency buttons, sign-out -- all working.

minor.issue: stats.avg_apy is skewed by high-APY outliers (~1869%); consider median or trimmed mean for display
Email is silently lowercased server-side; frontend/UX should communicate this or the API should reject mixed-case to avoid confusion

issues: avg APY displays as 1869.1% due to upstream DeFiLlama outlier pools (297994%); consider filtering apy > 1000% from avg calculation so the header doesn't look broken

action_items: Consider trimming extreme APY outliers (>1000%) before computing avg_apy in /api/opportunities/meta and before ranking in /api/opportunities so hero/stats strip shows a sensible average.
Optional: surface watchlist empty-state with a CTA linking to Opportunities; currently shows an empty indicator.

Optional: remove hard-coded fallback ADMIN_PASSWORD='admin123' in server.py startup; rely on env var to fail loudly if misconfigured (currently actual password from .env is used, so not a runtime bug).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=False`. OK because frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage (qy_token), not cookies. However set_auth_cookies() still writes cookies with SameSite=None which are effectively unused cross-origin -- consider removing cookie logic or enabling credentialed CORS with explicit origin.
Register endpoint returns 200 instead of 201 -- not a bug but REST convention.

fetch_yields() has no upstream retry/backoff; if DeFiLlama fails on first cold call and cache is empty, UI receives empty list silently. Consider returning a stale flag or a 503 to let UI show a retry state.
server.py is 499 lines. Still within the <700 guideline but as features grow, extract auth, opportunities, watchlist/alerts into routers.

classify_risk considers pool stable and safe only if project is in SAFE_PROTOCOLS; top of the list is dominated by `high` risk pools with unrealistic APYs. Add an outlier cap (apy >= 1000 => exclude).
seed_data_creation: Startup seed in server.py seeds admin and demo user idempotently; tests created and cleaned up their own watchlist/alerts under demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (12 tests, all passing). Uses Bearer token auth (login -> access_token -> Authorization header). DeFiLlama first call takes 5-15s; cache is 10 min. Resend email delivery for alerts is MOCKED (alert rules persist in Mongo, no emails sent, no cron). Frontend testids in use: landing-page, hero-cta-primary, auth-modal, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-btn, auth-switch-login/register, auth-error, opp-add-<id>. Watchlist/Alerts rows lack data-testid prefixes like wl-row-/alert-row- -- add these if deeper frontend testing is needed.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs found. Only cosmetic issue: avg APY in stats strip reads 1869.1% because DeFiLlama returns some pools with multi-thousand-% APYs and backend does not cap them. Fix: in fetch_yields() add `if (p.get('apy') or 0) > 1000: continue` or compute meta avg with median/trimmed mean.
